title: Check: a NotReady node
description: Five questions on nodes that stop participating.

questions.prompt: A node is NotReady. What do you read first?

options.text: kubectl describe node - the Conditions block

questions.explanation: Conditions name the reason in words: MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, or KubeletNotReady with a message.

questions.prompt: Conditions show 'container runtime network not ready'. What is missing?
questions.explanation: Every node stays NotReady after kubeadm init until a network plugin is installed.

questions.prompt: Write the command that follows the kubelet's logs on the node.
questions.explanation: The kubelet is a systemd unit, not a Pod - its logs are never in kubectl.

questions.prompt: A node stays NotReady. What happens to its Pods?

options.text: After the eviction timeout the controller marks them for deletion and reschedules them

questions.explanation: The node controller waits - about five minutes by default - because a brief network blip is not a dead node.

questions.prompt: The node reports DiskPressure. What is the kubelet doing?

options.text: Garbage-collecting images and evicting Pods to reclaim space

questions.explanation: Which shows up as evicted Pods that were never the cause. Fix the disk, not the workload.
